To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we propose a novel method that predicts the confidence in the quality of a multi-view stereo reconstruction in real-time, (ii) we demonstrate that our prediction is highly correlated with the actual quality of the multi-view stereo reconstruction, (iii) we use the prediction for on-site planning of further views and (iv) we demonstrate the capabilities of the system in challenging outdoor scenarios with an autonomous Unmaned Aerial Vehicle.

we present an autonomous image acquisition system for close-range high-resolution image acquisition that is able to predict the confidence of a later-on dense multi-view stereo 3D reconstruction without executing it.
(1) We present an autonomous UAV system for image acquisition with quality assurance and planning of further views.

the development of autonomous image acquisition strategies and quality assurance techniques that can be applied for a variety of 3D reconstruction tasks.
the following contributions: 1) We introduce a new quality assurance metric for 3D reconstruction that is based on dense multi-view stereo.

our approach is a significant contribution in the field of autonomous close-range image acquisition and that it can be applied to a variety of different scenarios.
this paper proposes an autonomous system for image acquisition that maximizes the quality of a 3D reconstruction by predicting its confidence and by using this confidence for planning the next view.
the presented approach is capable of autonomous acquisition of high-resolution close-range image data with respect to the quality of the later-on 3-D reconstruction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a system that autonomously acquires images with respect to the quality of a multi-view stereo 3D reconstruction.
we provide an end-to-end solution for autonomous image acquisition with multi-view stereo quality assurance.
we present the first UAV-based autonomous image acquisition system that uses confidence predictions of a multi-view stereo approach to maximize the quality of the final 3D reconstruction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we show that the quality of a 3D reconstruction is not only dependent on the quality of the images but also the quality of the image constellations.
we can use a single camera to predict the confidence of the multi-view stereo approach and to plan further views that are optimal in terms of the predicted confidence.
the confidence prediction allows to autonomously acquire images with high quality in terms of coverage, ground resolution, and 3D reconstruction accuracy.
